segments.text: In the Vikyan Bhairava Tantra, the Goddess Bhairavi asks a simple question,
how can I know Shiva? Bhairava answers,
watch your breath. Each breath is the pulse of Shakti, the living power within you.
The out-breath, called prana, rises from the heart and flows out through the nose,
twelve finger widths beyond the body, to a point called dva dasanta.
There, for a moment, the breath stops. Nothing moves. This still gap is the place of Shiva.
Then the in-breath, called jiva, returns, all the way back to the heart.
And at the heart, it turns again. A second gap, a second stillness.
Rest your attention in these two gaps. Don't force the breath, just notice the pause.
As you keep watching, the gap grows longer. And in that pause, you come to know, I am Bhairava.
